The photo shows only the meal before eating, so I can't see what will be left over. I assumed the person eats everything, which gives zero leftover. The figures below are estimates from the portions visible.

- **Raisin toast:** one slice, about 80 kcal, 2.5 g protein, 15 g carbs, 1.5 g fat. The slice looks large and may be a thick-cut or cut-in-half piece, so I used about 90 kcal, 3 g protein, 17 g carbs and 1.5 g fat.
- **Fried egg:** one egg, about 90 kcal, 6 g protein, 0.5 g carbs, 7 g fat.
- **Blueberries:** about 100 g (roughly 3/4 cup), about 57 kcal, 0.7 g protein, 14 g carbs, 0.3 g fat.
- **Water:** 0 kcal.

Totals are about 237 kcal, 9.7 g protein, 31.5 g carbs and 8.8 g fat.
